title: Tired of recording blues; preference for popular music
summary: He says every blues is the same and he preferred playing popular music.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the blues is, and why every jazz player needs it

blocks.x: Well, it looked like -- here, there and everyplace, here come another blues, another blues, another blues. And I had to make records of blues. Well, I got sick of them, because when you get down to fundamentals, the blues are nothing but the blues. And if you know one good blues solid, you can play any of them.
You were on a lot of records with different singers doing blues. It must have been very monotonous.

Yes, yes. Yes, but you know what I preferred? I preferred to play popular music. Because people seemed to like popular music. They danced better, they enjoyed it better, because they could sing and hum it. And the blues was just the blues. It's just different words and a different signature on top, that's all. But it was still the blues. So that's what it was.
